candidate_relations.label: Stromal keratitis, bilateral
candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record confirms bilateral stromal keratitis (immune ring formation, anterior stromal infiltrate) and anterior chamber reaction (uveitis component), with aqueous PCR positive for CHIKV and positive IgM serology. The candidate correctly identifies bilateral stromal keratitis but is missing the anterior uveitis component (making it keratouveitis rather than keratitis alone) and the defining Chikungunya virus etiology, both of which are required components of the benchmark reference.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures bilateral stromal keratitis component but omits the uveitis component and the specific Chikungunya virus etiology

case_quality_flags: Aqueous humor negative for CHIKV-specific immunoglobulins despite positive PCR — weak viral load and immune privilege may explain discordance; does not undermine diagnosis given systemic IgM positivity and clinical context
Periorbital hyperpigmentation noted as a distinctive CHIKV-associated dermatological manifestation supporting systemic CHIKV infection
